title: What's New in v2.9.27
notes: 🖥️ Expanded Admin Hub & Audit Logs: Expanded the maximum container width to 1300px for a widescreen layout and added custom high-contrast scrollbars with sticky column headers for smooth vertical and horizontal navigation.

latestChanges: v2.9.27: Expanded Admin Hub & Audit Logs window to 1300px and added custom high-contrast scrollbars with sticky column headers
v2.9.26: Supported multi-member target & breakdown parsing for single-entry batch logs (such as multi-player Bear Trap donations) with interactive modal details and badges
v2.9.25: Added interactive Batched Members Modal with copy button for seamless mobile and desktop inspection of grouped actions
v2.9.24: Added hover tooltip with numbered member names list to the orange batched pill in Admin Logs
v2.9.23: Redesigned Admin Action Audit Logs table layout, semantic category badges, and batch summaries
